Before you plan a change: match the files you expect to touch against **Applies to**, then read those records in full with `php tools/memory show <ID>` (or `php tools/memory for <path>`). For a concept that cuts across folders, grep the log.

| `app/Modules/**` | ADR-004 | Modules talk to each other only through Contracts |
